# Icefrog

Icefrog's name on the Six Heroes update post on Steam

**Icefrog** is a Valve developer. He is best known for his work as the lead developer of *Dota 2*.

Icefrog was reportedly involved with early development of *Neon Prime* and *Deadlock*.[1]

In a January 2024 interview, *Deadlock* artist Vasili Zorin said that Icefrog was working in the game at the time.[2]

Icefrog's name was noticed by players on the Six Heroes update Steam post, confirming his involvement on *Deadlock*.

# Imbue

Purchasing Compress Cooldown as Shiv presents the option to Imbue an ability.

Imbuement is a term for when an Item requires the player to choose a specific ability of the hero they are playing. Typically, the item will enhance only that ability, or provide a greater boost of Stats for that ability compared to the others.

Items refer to the selected ability as the Imbued Ability. Abilities not imbued by an item are referred to as Non-Imbued Abilities.

Ability imbuements are item-specific - imbuing two separate abilities using, for example,  Compress Cooldown and  Quicksilver Reload, will not grant both abilities the effect of both items. However, one ability can be imbued by multiple sources.

## Notable Interactions

[edit | edit source]

- Indomitable will prevent the player from being teleported to The Baroness if hit with  The Doorman's  Hotel Guest.
- Indomitable will not be triggered by  Dynamo's  Singularity.
- Indomitable is currently not triggered by  Apollo's  Itani Lo Sahn.
- Indomitable will trigger if the player is dragged down by  Lash's  Ground Strike and  Billy's  Bashdown, but will not detach the player from their immobilize & pull effects, which continue until they reach the floor.

- While performing a similar effect,  Phantom Strike's pull does not trigger Indomitable.
- Indomitable will prevent players from being stunned after being parried.
- Indomitable will prevent players from being stunned after getting hit by bullets while on a zipline. They will still fall off the zipline.
- Players still receive health damage that gets applied before the barrier comes up from the following abilities and items:

- Graves -  Grasping Hands
- Grey Talon -   Guided Owl
- Haze -  Sleep Dagger
- Holliday -  Spirit Lasso
- Infernus -  Concussive Combustion

“

They'll be nothin' but ash when I'm through.

**Infernus** is a Hero in *Deadlock*. He is an Ixian with a powerful control of flame that he uses to enhance his speed and ignite his enemies. Combining his Flame Dash with the ability to spew a Napalm catalyst, Infernus can chase down and ignite his foes with a deadly Afterburn. Any targets left standing will be subject to his explosive Concussive Combustion, knocking them out and leaving them vulnerable to further immolation.

As a creature from Ixia, Infernus had a troubled and intense youth while he was raised in the United States. Despite a rash of deadly crime as a teenager, he found himself tending a bar in his adulthood and learning to calm his intense emotions. With quality music and interesting people to talk to, Infernus rarely has a need these days to call up his dangerous supernatural abilities.

- Afterburn's Build-Up is affected by distance falloff. For example: if you are at a distance where you would do 50% damage due to distance falloff, a body shot will build up half as much afterburn as normal.
- A light melee has the same build-up as a body shot, and a heavy melee the same as a headshot.
- Afterburn ticks every half-second, for half its DPS each tick.
- Debuff Resist interactions:

- Does not affect the build-up in any way.
- Does reduce the duration of Afterburn when it triggers.
- Does not reduce the refresh duration when Infernus reapplies ongoing afterburn.

## Backstory

[edit | edit source]

*See **Infernus/Lore** for more story content.*

“

Like most teenagers; Infernus was wild, rebellious, and impetuous.  Unlike most teenagers, Infernus was a creature from another plane and had a supernatural mastery over fire.  Needless to say:  his youth was filled with no small amount of arson, murder, and evidence disposal.  But that was then.  Now an adult, Infernus has mellowed out considerably.  He’s happy working at a bar with good live music, and talking to interesting people.  That being said when someone at the bar gets belligerent or violent, he’s not afraid to dust off the skills he once honed.

Like most teenagers; Infernus was wild, rebellious, and impetuous.  Unlike most teenagers, Infernus was a creature from another plane and had a supernatural mastery over fire.  Needless to say:  his youth was filled with no small amount of arson, murder, and evidence disposal.  But that was then.  Now an adult, Infernus has mellowed out considerably.  He’s happy working at a bar with good live music, and talking to interesting people.  That being said when someone at the bar gets belligerent or violent, he’s not afraid to dust off the skills he once honed.

## Overview

[edit | edit source]

Infernus' motivation in the ritual is to prevent Jezebel's Billiards Hall, the bar he tends to, from getting shut down down.[1][2]

### Biography

[edit | edit source]

As a second generation Ixian immigrant,[3] Infernus was born and raised in New York and has never visited Ixia.[4] He considers New York his home and doesn't follow news about Ixia or the Ixian war.[5]

Infernus doesn't know how to speak Ixian because his parents only ever spoke English around him.[6]

Infernus used to work for the Mendoza Syndicate before he got replaced by  Vyper.[7] It's implied that he killed people at "Pier 31" during his youth.[8] When he was roughly 18 years old, he "needed help, and someone gave it to him",[9] likely referring to Hank saving his life and allowing him to leave his life of crime behind.[10]

Infernus' visual novel will tell of the story of Infernus trying to save Jezebel's.

### Personality

[edit | edit source]

Infernus is haunted by his past and worries that he'll enjoy the thrills of the ritual and potentially fall back into a life of crime.[11][12][13]

### Information

[edit | edit source]

Infernus claims to make the best sidecar in Manhattan.[14]

Infernus is always well-dressed.[15]

Infernus wants to watch Cadence's set after the ritual.[16]

## Character Relationships

[edit | edit source]

### Hank

[edit | edit source]

Hank is Infernus' boss and friend at Jezebel's.

Infernus mainly wants to save the bar for Hank's sake because Hank "saved his life".[17][18] As mentioned in the biography, Hank likely helped Infernus leave his life of crime behind.[9][10]

Since Infernus doesn't want Hank to worry about him, he hasn't told Hank about his involvement with the ritual.[19]

### Wraith

[edit | edit source]

Wraith and Infernus used to work together while Infernus was a criminal.[20] While on the same team, Wraith tries to coax Infernus back into his criminal past.[21][22]

Wraith believes Infernus' work as a bartender is "boring". She also believes Infernus misses her, but he denies it.[23]

Infernus plays in Wraith's weekly poker game.[24] However, he tells  Mo & Krill that he wants to stay away from Wraith out of fear of her pulling him back into crime.[25]

According to  Graves, Wraith told Blackmore Academy students that play cards with her about Infernus' criminal past "with the mob".[26]

### Lady Geist

[edit | edit source]

As someone who frequents Jezebel's, Lady Geist is friends with Infernus and Hank.[27]

Lady Geist refers to Infernus as "Fern" and "her bartender".[28][29] She likes Infernus' recipe of gin and tonic.[30]

As Jezebel's is under threat of closure, Lady Geist offers to help Infernus save the bar.[31] In one pathway in *The Binding of Oathkeeper,* Lady Geist gives Oathkeeper to Hank on the promise of providing the resources needed to keep the bar open.[32]

### Mo & Krill

[edit | edit source]

Infernus is friends with Mo and Krill.[33]

Mo & Krill are regular patrons at Jezebel's, and offer to help Infernus prevent Jezebel's from closing.[34]

### Celeste

[edit | edit source]

Infernus is friends with Celeste and her found family. Celeste invites Infernus to come over to say hi to her family at the sideshow.[35]

Celeste refers to Infernus as "Fern".[36] She's also familiar with Hank and asks Infernus how Hank is holding up.[37]

### Mina

[edit | edit source]

Infernus once kicked Mina out of Jezebel's for using a fake ID on her 16th birthday.[38] She attempted to bribe him with money, to which he declined.[39]

### The Doorman

[edit | edit source]

Infernus and The Doorman respect each other for being members of the service industry and are apologetic when fighting each other.[40][41][42]

### Infernus' other patrons

[edit | edit source]

As a bartender, Infernus is familiar with a lot of characters who frequent Jezebel's.

These characters include but aren't limited to:   Abrams,[43]  Kelvin,[44]  Lash,[45] ,  Pocket,[46] the Shopkeeper,[47]  Shiv,[48] and  Silver.[49]

## Character Interactions

[edit | edit source]

- Infernus seems to know Ms. Shelly, even though they've never met before.[50][51]
- Infernus invites Holliday for a "date" at Jezebel's.[52]
- Infernus knows Paige's parents and is apologetic about her brother, Bryce.[53][54]
- Infernus has invited  Holliday,  McGinnis and Viscous to Jezebel's.[52][55][56]
- Infernus' friends and regular patrons, like  Abrams,[57] Krill,[58]  Lady Geist,[59] Shiv,[60]  the Shopkeeper,[61]Victor[62] and  Wraith[63] call him **Fern**.
- Apollo is shocked that Infernus doesn't speak Ixian nor care for Ixian culture.[64][65]
- Seven,  Vyper and  Wraith tease Infernus for leaving his criminal life behind and becoming a bartender.[66][67][23]
- Grey Talon is remorseful when fighting Infernus, due to his feelings towards Ixians.[68][69]

## Removed Lore

[edit | edit source]

Inferno (Neon Prime)

Haze originally had kill lines against Infernus, implying that her intervention is why Infernus was able to walk free after his criminal youth.[70][71] These lines were removed in the Six New Heroes Update.

### Neon Prime - Inferno

[edit | edit source]

In Neon Prime, Infernus was originally a character named **Inferno**.

## Rolling Flame Dash

[edit | edit source]

Infernus’s second ability,  Flame Dash, allows Infernus to enter a dash state that leaves a flame trail that burns enemies. By holding forward button, he can accelerate even faster.

*Flame Dash* has to accelerate at the start. By casting *Flame Dash*, you will begin to accelerate to 472.23 u/s over a time span of a second. If you are holding W, you will accelerate to a peak of 787.18 u/s over two seconds.

By using **Rolling Flame Dash**, you instantly accelerate to top speed, without having to wait. This is done by dashing before casting *Flame Dash*.

To execute, dash then cast *Flame Dash*.

| Flame Dash Slide |  |

| Tech Type: | Character Tech |
| Difficulty: | Universal Basics |
| Inputs: | Flame Dash (cancel)By default, Space or 2 → Slide |

## Flame Dash Slide

[edit | edit source]

Flame Dash is eligible to be cancelled at any time during its duration. By cancelling, you are able to carry over some momentum from *Flame Dash* for a short timeframe.

During that time frame, you can execute a slide that uses the momentum from the cancelled *Flame Dash*. This is called a **Flame Dash Slide**.

To execute, cancel *Flame Dash* and immediately slide.

| Flame Dash Slide Bunnyhopping |  |

| https://deadlock.wiki/File:Infernusflamedashslidebhop.mp4 |  |
| Tech Type: | Character Tech |
| Difficulty: | Advanced Easy |
| Inputs: | Flame Dash (cancel)By default, Space or 2 → (hold) SlideBy default, CTRL → JumpBy default, Space → (while in the air, release and repress) Slide → Bunnyhop |

## Flame Dash Slide Bunnyhopping

[edit | edit source]

Main articles: Slide Bunnyhopping, Slide Storage

To start bunnyhopping after a Flame Dash Slide, you have to release the duck key while in the air and then quickly repress it again.

This is because Flame Dash Slide is not eligible for bunnyhopping, and you need Slide Storage to be able to bunnyhop.

To execute, release the duck key while in the air, then press it again to be able to bunnyhop.

# Infernus/Update history

Overview

Update history

Movement

Lore

Quotes

Sounds

| Update | Changes |
| --- | --- |
| April 30, 2026 | - Flame Dash DPS spirit scaling reduced from 1.0 to 0.7. - Flame Dash DPS now does half damage to objective.    Street Brawl:    - Flame Dash range reduced by 15%. |
| March 25, 2026 | - Afterburn DPS increased from 12 to 14. - Afterburn T1 DPS increased from +14 to +16. - Concussive Combustion T2 increased from +85% Explosion Lifesteal to +100%. - Concussive Combustion T2 increased from -65s Cooldown to -75s. |
| March 21, 2026 | - Reload time reduced from 2.491 to 2.25. - Flame Dash speed now moves faster by the same amount of speed above your base. - Concussive Combustion T2 increased from +65% Explosion Lifesteal to +85%. |
| March 6, 2026 | - Napalm damage reduced from 46 to 40. - Napalm damage spirit scaling increased from 0.3 to 0.6. - Napalm amplified damage taken reduced from 20% to 16%. - Napalm T2 lifesteal increased from 10% to 15%. - Flame Dash DPS spirit scaling increased from 0.8 to 1.0. - Flame Dash T1 changed from "-25% Fire Rate" to "-12s Cooldown". - Flame Dash T2 DPS reduced from +27 to +20. - Flame Dash T2 DPS now also increases trail duration by 1s. - Flame Dash T3 no longer reduces cooldown by 15s. - Flame Dash T3 now also grants +1 Charge. - Flame Dash T3 time between charges reduced from 20s to 14s. - Melee can now buildup afterburn (20% for light melee, 35% for heavy). - Afterburn T1 changed from "-20% Spirit Damage" to "+14 DPS". - Afterburn T2 changed from +1s Burn Duration to -35% Spirit Damage. - Afterburn T3 changed from "+23 DPS" to "+3s Max Burn Duration" (Base duration is the same, but can buildup after igniting to grow to max burn duration, abilities only refresh up to the base). - Concussive Combustion cast now causes camera to move back a bit. - Concussive Combustion delay increased from 3s to 3.25s. - Concussive Combustion radius reduced from 13m to 12m. - Concussive Combustion cooldown increased from 140s to 165s. - Concussive Combustion damage reduced from 150 to 125. - Concussive Combustion T1 changed from "-35s Cooldown" to "+100 Damage". - Concussive Combustion T2 changed from "+0.5s Stun and +3m Radius" to "-65s Cooldown and +65% Explosion Heal". - Concussive Combustion T3 changed from "+94 Damage and Heal for 70% damage" to "+0.75s Stun and +10m Radius". |
| January 22, 2026 | - **(Undocumented)** Updated VO pass |
| December 3, 2025 | - Base bullet damage reduced from 6.2 to 5.5 - Bullet falloff range from 20-58 to 18-55 - Afterburn now only adds 0.5s to the duration for each bullet that is hit after it procs, rather than fully refreshing the duration. Adds 1.0s for headshots. |
| November 21, 2025 | - Afterburn buildup is now 10% slower on body shots. - Napalm T3 damage amp reduced from +20% to +17%. |
| October 24, 2025 | - Bullet damage growth per boon reduced from 0.12 to 0.08. - Flame Dash T2 reduced from +35 to +30. - Afterburn T1 reduced from -25% Spirit Damage to -20%. - Afterburn T3 reduced from +28 DPS to +26. |
| September 4, 2025 | - Flame Dash DPS reduced from 33 to 30. - Flame Dash T2 reduced from +37 DPS to +35. |
| August 27, 2025 | - **(Undocumented)** Updated VO pass |
| July 4, 2025 | - Bullet damage growth per boon reduced from 0.16 to 0.12. - Afterburn DPS reduced by 13% (still affected by the global base reductions as well, so the total amount is larger than this. This applies to all other patch note lines that reduces damage as well). - Afterburn spirit scaling increased from 0.56 to 0.66. - Flame Dash T2 DPS reduced by 10%. - Flame Dash spirit power scaling increased from 0.7 to 0.8. |

Inhibitor's effect appears as a downward red arrow in the player's back and cause the player's model to lose color saturation.

## Notable interactions

[edit | edit source]

- Damage Reduction stacks additively with  Mirage's  Fire Scarabs.

## Buildup Per Shot

[edit | edit source]

The item has a different buildup per shot depending on which hero purchased the item. The status only triggers once a buildup reaches 100% on an enemy player, and the buildup decays back to 0 if an enemy hasn't been shot for some time. Melee attacks count as 1 shot.

Once Inhibited, subsequent shots refresh the duration of the effect.

**Intensifying Magazine** is a Tier 2  Weapon Item that can be purchased from the Shop for  **1,600**.

## Contents

- 1 Mechanics

- 1.1 Abilities that continue to allow building Intensifying Magazine damage during casting despite not shooting
- 2 Update history
- 3 Navigation

## Mechanics

[edit | edit source]

Intensifying Magazine ramps up the bonus weapon damage from 0% to 45% while the player holds down the Fire button and their weapon is in a firing state. Some abilities will still flag the hero as "firing" while the character isn't actually firing, but if the user continues to hold down their Fire button then they will continue charging up their bonus weapon damage. This can be used to charge up the bonus damage before a fight or maintain the bonus damage for longer.

### Abilities that continue to allow building Intensifying Magazine damage during casting despite not shooting

[edit | edit source]

- Bebop's  Exploding Uppercut
- Vindicta's  Assassinate (while scoped in)
- McGinnis'  Spectral Wall (Must be holding Fire before casting the wall)

Pressing the Alt-Fire button will not increase the bonus weapon damage, but players can hold both Fire and Alt-Fire at the same time. This will cause heroes to continuously use their Alternate fire but still build bonus damage.

## Overview

[edit | edit source]

There are currently **155** items available for purchase from any Curiosity Shop on the game map, as well as **17** Legendary items available only in the Street Brawl mode. Every item also has an "Enhanced" variant in Street Brawl {Enhanced stats can be found in each item's page).

Heroes start with nine item slots in their inventory which can hold an item of any type. Additionally, there are three Extra Slots that can be unlocked after completing certain map objectives.

Items are split into four tiers based on their price. All items within a tier have the same price. If an item has a component, the player gets a discount equal to the price of the component if they had purchased it first. If an item is a component to multiple items, the player only receives a discount on the first upgraded item.

Purchased items can be sold back to the shop, allowing the player to recoup half of the cost. The player can get the full value if they refund the item before closing the shop window.

## Item Types

[edit | edit source]

There are three types of items:

- ** Weapon**: Focus on improving base weapons, damage, and bullet effects.
- ** Vitality**: Focus on improving survivability, defense, and movement.
- ** Spirit**: Focus on improving abilities and spirit power.

Spending Souls on items of each type provides corresponding stats bonuses. The strength of the bonus is dependent on the total cost of the items of each type owned by the player, up to  **28,800** Souls.

At  **4,800**, the player gains a significant investment bonus.

## Active Items

[edit | edit source]

**Active items** provide additional, temporary effects when activated by a key press. Upon being purchased, they must be bound to one of four individual keys for activation. As a result, a player cannot hold more than four active items at a time.

A player can change the assigned slot for an active item by holding "Tab" or "Alt" and then clicking and dragging the item between slots.

## Cosmetic Items

[edit | edit source]

**Cosmetic items** are a unique type of active item that are only available during Seasonal events and specific periods. These items are globally unlocked for all players, don't take an item slot or provide bonus stats, and use a unique active item slot ("E" key).

These items can be tested outside their events by using the "giveitem" Console command in the Hideout, Sandbox, or cheat-enabled custom games.

- Snowball *(cosmetic_item_snowball)*
- Hero Vote Posters *(cosmetic_item_voting_poster)*

## Unreleased/Cut items (WIP)

[edit | edit source]

**Unreleased and cut items** are not obtainable through normal play. They can only be accessed via console commands and include both active and passive types. All details are provisional, and some items may change or never be added.

These items can be tested by using the "giveitem" Console command in the Hideout, Sandbox, or cheat-enabled custom games (add "upgrade_" before the item codename in lower caps).

# Chapter 1 - Career Day

[edit | edit source]

*Ivy meets with a job recruiter.*

**Interviewer:** So, Miss Ivy.

** Ivy:** Just Ivy is fine.

**Interviewer:** Okay, Ivy! That's a, heh, that's an interesting name for a gargoyle.

** Ivy:** it's a long story, thanks for meeting with me.

**Interviewer:** Well, anything for Carlos. So, what type of work are you looking for?

** Ivy:** Ah, that's the thing... I don't know. For the past 20 years I was so focused on cleaning up Spanish Harlem, I never really thought about what to do when I was finished.

**Interviewer:** Oh, so you have Municipal experience?

** Ivy:** N- no... just vigilante.

**Interviewer:** And how do you know Carlos?

** Ivy:** Ha, longer story.

**Interviewer:** But you're looking for a job.

** Ivy:** Yeah. The Arroyos are wonderful people, and Carlos would never ask me to pay rent but, like... now that Sophie's going to fancy college, I feel like I need to contribute. Not that dismantling the Mendoza Syndicate isn't contributing, that's just more... contributing with a "capital C", as opposed to like, buying groceries.

**Interviewer:** Right...

** Ivy:** So, I was hoping that... you know, you could point me in a direction.

**Interviewer:** Well, let's see what we can do! What are your hobbies?

** Ivy:** Uh, that don't involve violence?

**Interviewer:** Ideally...

** Ivy:** People watching! Though if I'm being real honest, that usually was the precursor to vigilante justice.

**Interviewer:** Okay... What about special skills?

** Ivy:** That also don't involve violence?

**Interviewer:** Please?

** Ivy:** I can... fly?

**Interviewer:** I can work with that! Anything else I should know?

** Ivy:** I care about people. Like... a lot. And I know that I'm not exactly your average applicant, but... I work hard. And I learn fast and I... I just want to help.

**Interviewer:** Okay. Well, what do you think about these?

**Choice between:**

*Take A Job As A Waitress - Take A Job As A Process Server - Go Home To Think About Your Options*

## 2b - Trust In The Process

[edit | edit source]

*Follows from Chapter 1 - "Career Day" if "Take A Job As A Process Server" was chosen.*
*Ivy begins her new job as a process server.*

** Ivy:** Uh... So, I wanna make sure I understand this. You want me to go up to criminals, but not punch them.

**Lawyer:** We don't know they're criminals.

** Ivy:** If they didn't do anything wrong, why are they being served?

**Lawyer:** Well they might have done something wrong, we don't know. All we care about is getting the piece of paper into their hands so they can know they have legal issues. Anything after that is not our problem.

** Ivy:** Okay. So, who am I not punching today?

**Lawyer:** Well, I got two options for you: First is a mobster, goes by " Wraith".

** Ivy:** Wa-wa-wa-wa-wait. Aren't mobsters criminals?

**Lawyer:** Oh yeah.

** Ivy:** You just said we didn't know they did something wrong!

**Lawyer:** In this case, we can make reasonable assumptions.

** Ivy:** So can I punch her?

**Lawyer:** No.

** Ivy:** Why not!

**Lawyer:** Two reasons: One, it's assault; two, everyone deserves due process.

** Ivy:** The law seems pretty stupid.

**Lawyer:** You have no idea.

** Ivy:** Well, who's the other option?

**Lawyer:** Jacob Lash.

** Ivy:** Who's that?

**Lawyer:** An asshole.

** Ivy:** Got it.

**Choice between:**

*Serve Wraith - Serve Lash*

“

Stick close to me, I'll do my best to protect you.

**Ivy** is a Hero in *Deadlock*. She is a gargoyle-turned-vigilante with potent supportive and disruptive abilities to assist her allies in combat. After setting up a Kudzu Connection with an ally to share healing and buffs, she can summon patches of Entangling Thorns and transform into her Stone Form to damage and stun the enemy while healing herself. With her abilities of flight, she can pick up any ally or bomb and fly them to any point on the battlefield, choosing to either explosively Air Drop them into the middle of the enemy battle group, or rescue an ally from danger.

Ivy's former life as an inanimate gargoyle ended abruptly when she was summoned to life to protect a girl and her family from The Mendoza Syndicate. Vowing to protect her new family, The Arroyos, Ivy began a vigilante mission to dismantle the Syndicate. After 18 years of work, she succeeded at defeating the organization, and now searches outside Spanish Harlem to find a new goal to dedicate her life to.

## Backstory

[edit | edit source]

*See **Ivy/Lore** for more story content.*

“

The gargoyle didn't know what was happening when it sprang to life...  just that a big human and a small human were being hurt.  And so the gargoyle leapt to action, sending the attackers fleeing in horror.  The small human said thank you and asked the gargoyle's name.  The gargoyle didn't have one.  And so the small human said, "I'm going to call you Ivy."  The gargoyle, being covered in ivy at the time, thought it was a bit obvious, but decided to go along with it for the small human's sake.

The humans asked if Ivy would come home with them so they could show their appreciation, and so Ivy walked with them.  That night she learned much.  The family were called The Arroyo's.  The little one, Sophia.  Mofongo is what they called a plate of deliciousness.  But most importantly, she learned that the people attacking them were called "The Mendoza Syndicate", and they were hurting people...nice people like The Arroyo's.

18 years have passed since the day the Arroyo's took Ivy home... and during that time she made it her mission to dismantle the Mendoza Syndicate and free Spanish Harlem from its grasp.  However the thing about dedicating your life to a single pursuit for nearly 2 decades is that you don't really know what to do once you achieve it.  For the first time in her life, Ivy is prepared to venture outside of Spanish Harlem and see what the world has to offer beyond vigilante justice.

- Ivy was named **Tengu** in *Neon Prime.*
- Several of Ivy's current animations are derived from those of Kali, an unreleased hero.
- Ivy's gun was originally called **Cat Dad's Fancy**.

- If Ivy is descending during  Stone Form when  Knockdown lands, the ability will stop abruptly in the air as if it had reached the ground, stunning nearby targets but not dragging them all the way to the ground.

## Air Drop

[edit | edit source]

Air Drop is  Ivy’s fourth and ultimate ability. In it, she (after a short wind up) launches into the air with a bomb and enters a flying state where she is constantly propelled forwards in the air. While flying, you can ascend, descend and accelerate. At any time, you can drop the bomb to inflict Movement Slow and (with the third and final upgrade) silence.

## Contents

- 1 Air Drop

- 1.1 Charge
- 1.2 Launch
- 1.3 Fly
- 1.4 Trajectories

- 1.4.1 Default Trajectory
- 1.4.2 Forward Trajectory
- 1.4.3 Low Trajectory
- 1.4.4 IAD Trajectory
- 1.4.5 Backwards Loop
- 2 References

*Air Drop* can be split into three phases:

### Charge

[edit | edit source]

This phase consists of Ivy flapping her wings, charging up *Air Drop*. You are unable to use other abilities or use active items that cannot Heavy Melee Cancel.

When charging, you are able to slowly move at 50 u/s (1.27 m/s). If not holding a movement key, you will launch straight upwards. If holding a movement key, you will move in that direction while launching upwards.

This phase lasts 82 ticks (1.28 seconds). The Charge phase is defined as the time from the activation of *Air Drop* to the first tick where you have vertical velocity.

When picking up an ally, there is a significantly shortened charge time. This can be used for quick escapes.

### Launch

[edit | edit source]

This phase consists of Ivy launching upwards into the air. You are unable to use other abilities or use active items that cannot Heavy Melee Cancel. This phase lasts 82 ticks (1.23 seconds). Launch phase is defined as the channel bar disappearing to the tick before you can drop someone.

### Fly

[edit | edit source]

This phase consists of Ivy flying forwards. This is the first phase where you are actionable and able to use other abilities or active items. You are not able to dash, downdash or air jump. This phase starts the tick you are able to drop someone. The duration of the fly phase can be extended with items with the *+Ability Duration* stat.

Ivy flies at a base speed of 461 u/s (11.7 m/s). By accelerating[1], you accelerate over a period of a second to a base speed of 735 u/s (18.67 m/s). This speed can be increased by buying items with either the *+Move Speed* stat or the *+Sprint Speed* stat.

### Trajectories

[edit | edit source]

#### Default Trajectory

[edit | edit source]

This is while not holding any inputs. This trajectory moves you vertically in the air, stops you, then moves you forwards. This is useful for when you want the height advantage in a close environment.

#### Forward Trajectory

[edit | edit source]

This is the most common trajectory. This puts you in a more natural and curved trajectory forwards. This is useful in outdoor scenarios where enemies are further away. To execute, hold forwards.

| Low Trajectory |  |

#### Low Trajectory

[edit | edit source]

This trajectory puts you closer to the ground.  This is executed by holding crouch in the charge phase of Air Drop. This can be useful for quicker bomb drops in close quarters environments

| IAD Trajectory |  |
| --- | --- |
| IAD Trajectory |  |
| Tech Type: | Character Tech |
| Inputs: | DashBy default, SHIFT after emerging from charge phase |

#### IAD Trajectory

[edit | edit source]

This trajectory puts you as close as you can get to the ground. This is executed by instantly dashing after emerging from charge phase and in launch phase. This can be useful in indoors environments.

| Backwards Loop Trajectory |  |
| --- | --- |
| Backwards Loop Trajectory |  |
| Tech Type: | Character Tech |
| Inputs: | Buffer movement key while in charge phase |

#### Backwards Loop

[edit | edit source]

This trajectory allows you to initially travel backwards when emerging from the launch phase into the fly phase. This can be executed by buffering the backwards movement key while in charge. You will travel up vertically, then fly backwards for a second and loop around back forwards. For the most part, this is a novelty. Uses include messing with opponents and trolling.

The little one, Sophia.  Mofongo is what they called a plate of deliciousness.  But most importantly, she learned that the people attacking them were called "The Mendoza Syndicate", and they were hurting people...nice people like The Arroyo's.

However the thing about dedicating your life to a single pursuit for nearly 2 decades is that you don't really know what to do once you achieve it.  For the first time in her life, Ivy is prepared to venture outside of Spanish Harlem and see what the world has to offer beyond vigilante justice.

## Overview

[edit | edit source]

Ivy has a few motivations for being in the ritual. She wants to keep Spanish Harlem safe,[1] make life better for the Arroyos,[2][3] find her new purpose in life now that the Mendoza Syndicate has been dismantled,[4][5] help Carlos Arroyo secure his place as New York's mayor,[6][7] and (if she finds out about Sophia's job as  Wraith's bookmaker)[8][9] keep Sophia out of trouble.[10]

### Biography

[edit | edit source]

Ivy has been alive for 20 years.[11] She doesn't know who created her, but she doesn't care since "her life started when she met the Arroyos".[12]

Ivy's visual novel will show her efforts to get a job and support the Arroyos.

### Personality

[edit | edit source]

Ivy is kind and friendly to others. She dislikes organized crime due to her history with Mendoza.[13][14] She prefers to fight crime without resorting to killing.[15]

### Information

[edit | edit source]

Ivy has only recently started leaving Spanish Harlem, and is looking forward to sightseeing.[16] She wants to watch South Pacific.[17]

Ivy is referred to as "the savior of Spanish Harlem",[18][19] but she doesn't like the nickname.[20]

Ivy's efforts to save Spanish Harlem were reported by news in Illinois, due to public interest.[21]

## Character Relationships

[edit | edit source]

### The Arroyos

[edit | edit source]

Ivy's sister, Sophia Arroyo (or Sophie), is studying at university under Dynamo,[22] and works with  Wraith to pay for her tuition.[9] Carlos Arroyo is a 1st-grade teacher[23] who's running an election campaign for mayor of New York City.[24][7] Carlos' wife is named Maria.[25] Ivy also has a little brother named Manny,[26] who's a fan of Kelvin.[27] The Arroyos are implied to be Catholic.[28]

Ivy is reluctant to leave the Arroyos on their own for too long.[29][30] This could be due to the fear that the Arroyos will be hurt if she's away from them for too long.[31][32][33]

### Dynamo

[edit | edit source]

With Sophia being a university student under Dynamo, Ivy worries her fighting Dynamo during the ritual would preconceive him against Sophia.[34] Dynamo reaffirms Ivy that Sophia's grades won't be affected by Ivy's actions in the ritual.[35] He warns Ivy that Sophia fell asleep during class due to her job, which Ivy didn't know about.[36]

### Lash

[edit | edit source]

Lash likes Ivy due to Mendoza's hatred towards both of them.[37][38] In one of the storylines in Ivy's Visual Novel, he helps her go after Mendoza.

### Vyper

[edit | edit source]

Ivy knows Vyper from when Vyper used to work for Mendoza.[39][40][41] Vyper knows that Sophia is working for Wraith, but doesn't want to get involved in "family drama".[8]

### Wraith

[edit | edit source]

Ivy doesn't trust Wraith and warns her to stay out of Spanish Harlem.[13][14] In one of the storylines in Ivy's Visual Novel, Ivy finds out that Sophia is working for Wraith.[9]

## Character Interactions

[edit | edit source]

- Most characters like Ivy and are apologetic when fighting her.[42]
- Ivy is naturally distrustful towards other criminals, especially  Wraith and  Yamato,[43] who are both leaders of their own criminal organizations.
- Ivy knows Paige from Manny Arroyo's story time.[44] She likes Paige and wants to start a book club with her.[45][46]
- Ivy invites Bebop and Ms. Shelly over to visit the Arroyos.[47]
- Ivy expresses admiration for  Shiv[48] and calls him a "shampoo ad with knives".[49]
- Billy believes that Ivy is a stooge who was used by Carlos Arroyo to become mayor.[50][51]
- Haze appreciates what Ivy did for New York, but believes she wouldn't be a good OSIC agent due to her big heart.[52][53]
- Seven respects Ivy for fighting for her ideals.[54]
- Apollo respects Ivy but believes she shouldn't have saved Spanish Harlem, instead believing that they should've saved themselves rather than rely solely on Ivy.[55][56]
- Vindicta believes Ivy is naive and warns her that, if she doesn't smarten up soon, someone she cares about will be hurt.[15]
- Warden respects Ivy,[57] but he also believes she's "meddling in things she doesn't understand".[58]

| April 30, 2026 | Street Brawl:    - Entangling Thorns range reduced by 15%. |
| March 21, 2026 | - Stone Form spirit scaling reduced from 0.8 to 0.6. - Stone Form T3 spirit scaling reduced from +2 to +1.7. - Air Drop ally cast range increased from 18m to 22m. - Air Drop is no longer disabled by damage over time abilities (same as zipline rules) - Air Drop cooldown increased from 65s to 85s. - Air Drop cooldown is reduced by 25% when used on allies. |
| March 10, 2026 | - Bullet damage growth increased from 0.06 to 0.08. - Kudzu Connection now only gives you half the bonus if you aren't connected to an ally. - Air Drop damage spirit scaling reduced from 1 to 0.7. - Air Drop T1 barrier spirit scaling reduced from 1 to 0.7. - Air Drop T2 slow reduced from 50% to 40%. |
| March 7, 2026 | - Entangling Thorns spirit scaling reduced from 0.55 to 0.45. |

# Ixia

Apollo, the "Prince of Ixia"

“

His son's wife was an Ixian who could snuff out flame with a thought.

— Grey Talon's background

**Ixia** is an Outer Plane connected to Earth through an astral gate.[1]

## Contents

- 1 Summary

- 1.1 South Ixia
- 1.2 North Ixia
- 2 Ixians

- 2.1 Known Ixians
- 3 Language
- 4 Gallery
- 5 Trivia
- 6 Removed Lore
- 7 References

## Summary

[edit | edit source]

Ixia is described as a beautiful place and a popular tourism destination.[2][3][4]

The US government is sending aid to Ixia as part of their military campaign, drawing opposition from the Friends of Humanity.[5] The Ixian War is a divisive political topic.[6]

Apollo is referred to as *The Prince of Ixia*[7]  or *Crown Prince of North Ixia,* though he finds the title inaccurate.[8] His father is referred to as a warlord, and has the authority equivalent to a governor and a general.[9] Apollo wants to represent Ixia in the Olympics.[10]

Kelvin has done an expedition to Ixia.[11]  Grey Talon has visited South Ixia.[3]

### South Ixia

[edit | edit source]

**South Ixia** is the 52nd state of the United States. The anniversary of its annexation is celebrated across the country.[12]

### North Ixia

[edit | edit source]

**North Ixia** is a sovereign region described as "a land of beauty, tradition and conflict", in which notable battles have occurred. It is plagued by political violence, which forced Apollo to move to New York.[2][13][14]

## Ixians

[edit | edit source]

**Ixians** are beings native to Ixia, colloquially called *demons* by some, a term that  Apollo finds offensive.[15][16][17] After the first Maelstrom, some Ixians have immigrated to Earth, leading to a new population of Earth-born Ixians.  Infernus and the daughter-in-law of  Grey Talon are some of them.[1][18][19]

Ixians are characterized by a demon-like appearance with horns and a tail (with the exception of Infernus) and a variety of skin colors including red, blue and black. Some of them have a supernatural control of fire, manifested in Infernus and in Grey Talon's daughter-in-law.

Infernus has never visited Ixia, as he was born and raised in New York.  Abrams is surprised to learn this, implying that he has visited Ixia.[20] Infernus doesn't speak Ixian nor is familiar with the language, as his parents only speak English around him. He believes they moved to New York because they were unhappy in Ixia.[18] Apollo is surprised that Infernus does not recognize him.[21]

Cadence is a popular Ixian singer.[22]

It seems to be possible for Ixians to have children with humans.[19] It's currently unknown if these "half-Ixians" inherit all the Ixian traits from their parent.

Apollo uses "gods" as an interjection, indicating that Ixians may have a polytheistic religion.[23][24][25]

### Known Ixians

[edit | edit source]

- Abrams[26]
- Apollo ("Prince of Ixia") and his father ("Warlord of Ixia")
- Cadence
- Infernus and his family
- Grey Talon's daughter-in-law (deceased)

## Language

[edit | edit source]

Ixia has its own language. As a native Ixian,  Apollo is fluent.  Rem and  Seven use Ixian phrases.[27][28]  Infernus doesn't speak Ixian.[18]

Examples of Ixian sentences:

- *"Itani Lo Sahn"* (Apollo's ultimate) - *"I have no equal"[29]*
- *"Hasha Vogali" - "Death's Whisper"*[30]

- *"Shioth valosh, Apollo."* (Either a farewell or an insult)
- *"Sirosi galah, Infernus."* (Presumably a greeting)

## Gallery

[edit | edit source]

- Abrams
- Apollo
- Infernus
- *Arch apartment Ixia* building type
- *Ixia hair braiding and Conjuring* sign (unused)

## Trivia

[edit | edit source]

- Infernus has a tail in *The Binding of Oathkeeper* artwork and in one of his earlier models.

- Abrams has spikes in *The Binding of Oathkeeper* artwork.
- Ixia's name may be a reference to the nine circles of Hell in *Dante's Inferno,* as IX is the Roman numeral for 9.

- It also shares its name with the planet Ix from *Dune*, whose inhabitants are also known as Ixians.
- One of the building types in the Cursed Apple is labeled *"Arch_apartment_ixia"* in the game files.
- There is an unused texture for a sign advertising *"Ixia hair braiding and Conjuring"*.
- In a removed voice line,  Dynamo describes a fellow professor's birth place as an "infernal hellscape", presumably a reference to Ixia.[31]
- Grey Talon's background originally read *"his son's wife was Ixian... she could snuff out flame with a thought".* The new wording *("an Ixian who could snuff out flames")* removes the implication that all Ixians can control fire.
- Many item and ability icons use the silhouette of an Ixian character as a symbol.

## Removed Lore

[edit | edit source]

Wrecker is known as *The Butcher of Ixia.*[32] He fought in the fields of North Ixia.[13]

# Jezebel's

Jezebel's Billiard Hall from The Binding of Oathkeeper.  

“

You should stop by Jezebel's sometime. If you like people watching, you'll see all types there.

— Infernus

Jezebel's is a sketchy yet popular bar located in New York.

## Contents

- 1 Summary

- 1.1 Hank
- 2 Gallery
- 3 Trivia
- 4 References

## Summary

[edit | edit source]

Jezebel's is an old church renovated into a billiard's hall and bar. The place is run by a man named Hank and tended to by  Infernus, who doubles as the bar's bouncer.[1]

Jezebel's is described in The New York Oracle as a place where people can bet their souls over a game of pool.[2]

Shortly before the events of the game take place, Jezebel's is under threat of getting shut down by the Alchemy Bureau due to a large number of infractions, including gambling souls without a license, distributing spirits from Ixia without a permit, and not having the Hex & Alchemy Bureau authorize a ward at the bar's entrance. Infernus and Hank are given 2 weeks to resolve the infractions.[3]

### Hank

[edit | edit source]

Hank

Hank is a portly, middle-aged man who owns Jezebel's.[4][5] He's worried about the bar's infractions and is willing to "make a deal with the devil himself" in order to save his bar.[6][7]

The threat of Jezebel's being shut down and what it means for Hank is why Infernus is participating in the ritual.[8][9] Since Infernus doesn't want Hank to worry about him, he hasn't told Hank about his involvement with the ritual.[10]

Infernus mentions that Hank "saved his life".[11] The implication seems to be that Hank helped Infernus move on from his criminal youth and turn over a new leaf as a bartender.[12]

Hank is also implied to be friends with Celeste,[10]  Lady Geist,[7] and Mo & Krill.[13]

In one pathway in *The Binding of Oathkeeper*, Lady Geist pawns off Oathkeeper to Hank on the promise of getting Hank the resources needed to save Jezebel's.[7]

## Gallery

[edit | edit source]

All images are from *The Binding of Oathkeeper*.

- Jezebel's Backroom
- Jezebel's Bar
- Booth on the second floor

## Trivia

[edit | edit source]

- The full name of Jezebel's seems to be "Jezebel's Billard Hall".[2]
- McGinnis describes Jezebel's as "too fancy".[14]
- The characters that currently frequent Jezebel's include but aren't limited to  Abrams,[15]  Kelvin,[16]  Lady Geist,[17]  Lash,[18]  Mo & Krill,[19], Pocket,[20] the Shopkeeper,[21]  Shiv,[22] Silver,[23] and  Wraith.[24] Infernus has invited  Holliday,[25] McGinnis,[26] and Viscous[27] to Jezebel's in their conversations. Vyper also goes to Jezebel's,[28] even though she's been barred.[29] Mina once went to Jezebel's on her 16th birthday, but was carded by Infernus.[30]

- Lady Geist and Krill offer to help prevent Jezebel's from closing.[6][13]
- Viscous asks Infernus why the bar isn't called "Hank's" instead of Jezebel's. Infernus answers that it's a long story.[31]
- During the festive season, Jezebel's has a promotion of a free cup of hot chocolate for every game of pool.[32]

# Johann Geist Jr.

Johann Geist Jr. from The Binding of Oathkeeper

“

At this moment, his two favorite hobbies are medicine, and being sanctimonious.

— Lady Geist

Doctor Johann Geist Jr. is the grandson of  Lady Geist.

## Contents

- 1 Summary
- 2 The Binding of Oathkeeper

- 2.1 Storyline C, D, E and F
- 2.2 Storyline G and H
- 2.3 Storyline I
- 3 Trivia
- 4 References

## Summary

[edit | edit source]

Johann Geist Jr. is a doctor born in New York.[1] He is the son of Walter Geist, and the grandson of Johann Geist and  Lady Jeanne Geist.

Johann Jr.'s known patients include Lady Geist and Ms. Shelly. Like his father before him, Johann Jr. repairs and maintains the ward Lady Geist uses to contain Oathkeeper.

Johann is aware that Lady Geist kills people to feed Oathkeeper, although he hasn't seen any of her victims before *The Binding of Oathkeeper*.[2] Johann shows contempt towards Oathkeeper and has gotten into arguments with Lady Geist in the past over him.[3]

Lady Geist refers to Johann as "one of the best doctors in New York,"[4] although she also thinks he can be sanctimonious.[5]

Johann holds his father in high regard.[6]

## The Binding of Oathkeeper

[edit | edit source]

*Content below contains spoilers for The Binding of Oathkeeper*

Johann Jr. is one of the main characters in Lady Geist's visual novel: *The Binding of Oathkeeper*. His role and fate depends on what choices Lady Geist makes during the story.

In Chapter 1, Lady Geist calls Johann Jr. over to inspect Oathkeeper's weakening ward. Johann tells Geist that Oathkeeper is getting close to breaking the ward and that he can't build a better ward. After getting threatened by Lady Geist, Johann suggests learning more about Oathkeeper, or learning more about Wards.[7]

Johann has little to no impact in storylines A and B past Chapter 1, beyond contacting  Dynamo to talk to Lady Geist in Chapter 2a.[8]

### Storyline C, D, E and F

[edit | edit source]

In Chapter 2b, Johann Jr. tells Lady Geist what he learned about Oathkeeper from Walter Geist's research.

In Chapter 4d, Lady Geist wants to transfer Oathkeeper to Johann Jr., which he passionately refuses. Johann suggests Geist give Oathkeeper to some other terrible person she knows such as Maximilian Fairfax, but takes it back once Geist points out that Fairfax would likely weaponize Oathkeeper for the Occult Industrial Complex. After Lady Geist suggests giving Oathkeeper to Shelly Fisher, Johann snaps and tells Geist that there's no cure for Oathkeeper and that her time is up before leaving.

Johann doesn't appear again in storyline C, D, E or F, but he does contact Ms. Shelly to warn her about Lady Geist and Oathkeeper.[9]

### Storyline G and H

[edit | edit source]

In Chapter 3c, Lady Geist decides to try and play off Oathkeeper's cruelty. To do this, they plan to summon the Patrons to keep Oathkeeper obedient for 200 years at the cost of Johann Jr.'s life.

The plan is put into action in Chapter 3d, where Lady Geist calls Johann over for a cup of tea. Johann asks about Oathkeeper, where Geist reveals the plan to make a deal with the Patrons. Johann asks why she doesn't just banish Oathkeeper, as he believed the point of the Oathkeeper problem was to get rid of him. Lady Geist reveals that she has no intention of giving up Oathkeeper, which causes Johann to refuse to have any part in Geist's plan. Unfortunately for Johann, the tea he drank was drugged, causing him to fall unconscious.

In Chapter 5g, Lady Geist succeeds in summoning the Patron and takes Johann Jr. to them. She demands a sacrifice: Johann's life for 200 years of obidience from Oathkeeper. Johann begs Geist to stop, while Oathkeeper consents to the deal. Johann is killed as the Patron grants the wish, leaving his bloody body lying in an alleyway.

In Chapter 5h, Lady Geist succeeds in summoning the Patron, just like in Chapter 5g. Right before she makes her wish, she remembers the time she first held Johann Jr. as a baby, with her son Walter Geist by her side. The memories of her family causes Lady Geist to change her wish at the last moment, sacrificing herself to banish Oathkeeper from Earth's realm. Some time passes as Johann visits the Geist family's grave, and while he's still a little shaken by Geist almost killing him, he ultimately thanks her.

### Storyline I

[edit | edit source]

Beyond Chapter 2b, Johann Jr. doesn't appear in Storyline I until Chapter 5, after Lady Geist succeeds in summoning the Patron and seperates herself from Oathkeeper. Deciding to enjoy the rest of her life in Paris, Geist and Johann wait for her flight at an airport. Geist thanks Johann for his help and tells him he's very much his father's son, which he appreciates. She also leaves him a bag of valuables as payment for being a difficult patient for Johann.

## Trivia

[edit | edit source]

- Lady Geist thinks Johann Jr. would like  Paige.[10]
- Johann Jr. occasionally refers to  Lady Geist as "Oma", which means "Grandma" in German and Dutch.[11][12]
- Johann Jr. and  Lady Geist have the same eyes.[13]
- Infernus is familar with Johann Jr. He thinks Johann is a "good kid."[5]

# Jump pad

A jump pad.

**Jump Pads**, also known as  **Bounce Pads**, **Launch Pads** or **Air Vents**, are structures on the Map that launch a player in the air in a specific direction, indicated by the wind above the pad.

## Overview

[edit | edit source]

The landing location is usually indicated by a white graffiti on the ground. The player can air strafe by looking and moving to a different direction mid-jump.

Taking damage in the first 0.6s after using a Jump Pad will stun the player until 0.2s after landing, apply a 30% slow for 2s, and deal 15% Max Health damage.

Holliday has the ability to place  Bounce Pads. Holliday's pads launch the player upwards in the direction they were moving on the ground.

# Jumping

| Jumping |  |
| --- | --- |
| https://deadlock.wiki/File:Jumping.mp4 |  |
| Tech Type: | Universal Tech |
| Difficulty: | Basic Mechanics |
| Character Dependent: | No |
| Inputs: | JumpBy default, Space |

**Jumping** is a fundamental part of movement in **Deadlock**. Jumping allows you to reposition to higher places. In Deadlock, you can jump on the ground and in the air.  
A jump in the air is called an *Air Jump* or a *Double Jump*.

Jumping on the ground does not use stamina. Ground jumping sends you at a peak speed of 295 u/s and at a max height of +45 units.  
Jumping in the air, or Air Jumping, costs one bar of stamina.  
For every hero, at the start of each game you are only permitted one air jump. This can be expanded to two with the  Vitality Item  Stamina Mastery ( **3,200**).

# Kaori

Kaori's profile picture in March 2025
Kaori on the official Deadlock Discord

**Kaori** is a *Deadlock* developer. Their username in the official *Deadlock* Discord is *@kaori05908*.

Kaori records the character's voice lines, and as such they are a reliable source for confirming voice actors.[1] However, they won't confirm a casting unless the dev team has "locked down" a character's voice and design, as the game is still in development.[2] They have further clarified that, due to the unpredictable nature of development, some actors may still be recast even after they have been confirmed or recognized by the community.[3][4]

Kaori is nicknamed after Yamato's real name.[5]

“

In life, I find that a positive outlook - and a freeze ray - makes all the difference in the world.

**Kelvin** is a Hero in *Deadlock*. He is a dedicated, undead scientist with a bevy of freezing abilities to slow his enemies and heal allies. He can conjure an Ice Path under his feet for faster movement for himself and his team, throwing Frost Grenades and  firing his Arctic Beam at nearby enemies to set them up for his companions' attacks. Tactical usage of his Frozen Shelter ice dome can protect and heal allies while trapping hapless opponents.

As an adventuring scientist, Kelvin was particularly excited for rumors of an 8th Astral Gate opening in the Arctic, developing an expedition to hunt for it. However, something went wrong with the expedition, vanishing into the snow and leaving Kelvin's frozen, animate body to be discovered over a year later. With no memory of the expedition, Kelvin seeks the Patrons for answers.

## Backstory

[edit | edit source]

*See **Kelvin/Lore** for more story content.*

“

A famed adventuring scientist, Kelvin made it his life's mission to explore and understand the unknowable.  So naturally when rumors surfaced regarding an 8th astral gate hidden in the arctic, Kelvin couldn't build an expedition team fast enough.  Assembling the brightest minds of his generation, Kelvin and his team set forth with much fanfare.

They never returned.

A year and a half later the frozen body of Kelvin was found by a fishing trawler, his corpse clutching a rock etched with glowing runes.  The crew chipped away at the ice, looking to get a closer look at the body and were shocked when Kelvin opened his eyes.  They checked his vitals... there was no pulse.  They sought to bandage his open wounds... there was no blood.  And yet, impossibly, Kelvin was "alive".

Having no memory of what happened on the expedition, Kelvin is looking for answers.

This page is under construction. To avoid edit conflicts, please consult the edit history and the talk page.

A famed adventuring scientist, Kelvin made it his life's mission to explore and understand the unknowable.  So naturally when rumors surfaced regarding an 8th astral gate hidden in the arctic, Kelvin couldn't build an expedition team fast enough.  Assembling the brightest minds of his generation, Kelvin and his team set forth with much fanfare.

They never returned.

A year and a half later the frozen body of Kelvin was found by a fishing trawler, his corpse clutching a rock etched with glowing runes.  The crew chipped away at the ice, looking to get a closer look at the body and were shocked when Kelvin opened his eyes.  They checked his vitals... there was no pulse.  They sought to bandage his open wounds... there was no blood.  And yet, impossibly, Kelvin was "alive".

Having no memory of what happened on the expedition, Kelvin is looking for answers.

## Overview

[edit | edit source]

Kelvin's motivation and wish in the ritual is to rediscover what happened during the expedition to the Arctic.[1][2]

### Biography

[edit | edit source]

As a famous explorer, Kelvin has written successful books about his adventures.[3][4] One of his past expeditions was located at Ixia.[5]

Kelvin is consistently called an "Ice Wight" due to his undead state.[6] Kelvin believes the correct term is "Revenant", although he's unsure if there's really a difference.[7]

Kelvin's ice abilities were created with a mix of science and magic.[8][9] They seem unrelated to his glowing rock or undead condition, although he claims to be the only person able to safely use Arctic Beam.[10][11] This is due to the fact that Kelvin doesn't get cold anymore.[12]

### Personality

[edit | edit source]

Kelvin exhibits a boastful personality.[13][14] He seems to have a reputation for being a little judgmental.[15]

Kelvin allegedly wrestles with a lot of guilt about the expedition.[16] He's been meeting with family members of his crewmates who never returned from it.[17] Despite the guilt, Kelvin remains optimistic about the ritual and his future.[18][19]

Kelvin views his undead state as a gift.[20]

### Information

[edit | edit source]

The OSIC want to ask Kelvin questions about his undead condition.[21]

Kelvin hasn't taken off his parka since the expedition just in case the glowing rock strapped to his body is the only thing keeping him alive.[22]

Kelvin likes to drink single malt Scotch.[23][24] He used to frequent Jezebel's before his Arctic expedition.[25]

Kelvin's parka smells.[26][27]

## Character Relationships

[edit | edit source]

### Ettrick

[edit | edit source]

One of Kelvin's old friends was someone named "Ettrick", who Kelvin pushed away due to Ettrick's ambitions.[28] At the fundraiser for Kelvin's Arctic expedition, Ettrick "made a scene". When Kelvin returned from the expedition, he tried to find Ettrick but couldn't.[29] Kelvin seems remorseful about Ettrick, and believes that "if someone's going to kill him, it's going to be Ettrick".[30][31]

### Seven

[edit | edit source]

Seven has a one-sided hatred towards Kelvin for unknown reasons.[32][33][34]

Kelvin thinks Seven "seems familiar".[35] When being healed by Kelvin, Seven is reminded of "old times".[36]

Both Seven and Kelvin have an interest on researching Astral Gates.[37][38]

Seven believes Kelvin has a bigger ego than  Lash.[39]

A likely possibility is that Seven is Kelvin's old friend Ettrick. This is supported by one of Seven's lines to Kelvin that mirrors one of Kelvin's lines about Ettrick.[40][41] Kelvin pushed Ettrick away due to his "ambition", which aligns with Seven's ambition to achieve apotheosis.[42] Seven also believes that mentors "use the young to achieve glories they could not achieve on their own", possibly referring to Kelvin.[43]

### Dynamo

[edit | edit source]

Dynamo and Kelvin are friends. They last saw each other at the Black Château, before Kelvin disappeared.[44]

Dynamo is a fan of Kelvin's books.[45]

Dynamo sometimes refers to Kelvin as "Kevin".[46]

### Lady Geist

[edit | edit source]

Kelvin's Arctic expedition was funded by Lady Geist.[47][48] Lady Geist takes great offense if Kelvin is on the enemy team.[49][50]

### Victor

[edit | edit source]

Kelvin and Victor promised each other that they'd stick together, as they're both walking corpses.[51][52]

-Paige(?)

-Paradox(?)

-Graves(?)

-McGinnis(?)

## Character Interactions

[edit | edit source]

- Kelvin understands why  Grey Talon and  Vindicta are consumed by rage and is sorry for them, but insists that their rage won't grant them peace.[53][54][55][56]
- Kelvin admires  Mo & Krill's friendship.[57]
- Kelvin is one of  Paradox's targets.[58] According to Paradox, the Paradox Organisation holds Kelvin in high regards.[59]
- Apollo,[60]  Dynamo,[61] Graves,[62] Ms. Shelly,[63]  Mo & Krill and  Ivy's brother (Manny) have read stories about Kelvin's adventures.[64]

- Paige has also read Kelvin's books and idolises him.[65][66]
- McGinnis consistently refers to Kelvin as "Kevin".[67][68][69]
- Graves believes her mentor would love to get her hands on Kelvin's stone.[70] She also thinks that might be able to help Kelvin with his undead condition.[71]
- According to Rem, Kelvin smells like "nice s'mores".[72] This contrasts Seven's scent of "evil s'mores".[73]

**Knockdown** is a Tier 3  Spirit Item that can be purchased from the Shop for  **3,200**.

## Contents

- 1 Notes
- 2 Notable Interactions
- 3 Update history
- 4 Navigation

## Notes

[edit | edit source]

The bonus stun duration scales based on the target's height when hit, reaching its maximum +1.5s duration against targets 30m or higher in the air.

## Notable Interactions

[edit | edit source]

Knockdown is a strong counter to the following:

**Flying Heroes**

- Vindicta
- Grey Talon

**Channeled Abilities**

- Bebop —  Hyper Beam
- Dynamo —  Singularity
- Haze —  Bullet Dance
- Ivy —  Air Drop
- McGinnis —  Heavy Barrage
- Seven —  Storm Cloud

“

The lives of the weak are meant to sustain the lives of the strong.

**Lady Geist** is a Hero in *Deadlock*. A socialite with a necromantic pact, Lady Geist consumes her own health for her abilities while draining the life away from opponents. Sacrificing her life force to launch Essence Bombs and Malice "Blood Shards", Lady Geist can regain lost health with Life Drain, sapping enemy heroes and units of their health. Her Soul Exchange swaps health values with an enemy hero, turning the odds against them for a killing blow.

The Toast of the Town, Lady Geist was famed by all and invited to every ball and gala in the city... until her beauty faded in her old age and left her with only memories and stories of her glory. In desperation, she formed a pact with a powerful spirit and bound it by powerful wards until she was safe and young again. All she needs to do now is feed on the life force of her fellows to maintain her beauty... and hope desperately that the Oathkeeper will stay bound.

## Backstory

[edit | edit source]

*See **Lady Geist/Lore** for more story content.*

“

Once, Lady Jeanne Geist was the toast of the town.  But as time passed and her beauty faded she found herself further and further from her glory days in High Society until finally she was nothing more than a frail woman in a nursing home, telling stories of a glorious past.  And that’s when Oathkeeper revealed himself.  A powerful spirit from another plane, Oathkeeper offered her a path to reclaim her past glories… he could restore her youth; all she had to do was drain the essence of the living to sustain herself. 

Geist was torn.  Obviously murder was ghoulish business, and undoubtedly Oathkeeper was not an entity that could be trusted… but still, the thought of having a second chance of reliving her youth was too good to pass up.  And so she concocted a plan: after making a pact with Oathkeeper she would bind and ward him, limiting his influence and pull over her.  Oathkeeper would still get fed; but on her terms, not his.

However, as years have turned to decades; the strength of the Ward has weakened, and Oathkeeper hungers more than he ever has in the past…

## Trivia

[edit | edit source]

- Geist is a German word that can be translated as "spirit/mind".
- Lady Geist is French, but she uses her late German husband's last name.
- Lady Geist is referred to as "Oma" (German: *grandma*) by her grandson Johann Jr.
- Alongside  Mina, Lady Geist is one of the few heroes to holds her gun in the left hand, as Oathkeeper is in her right arm in-game. However, in a concept art and in *The Binding of Oathkeeper* artwork, Oathkeeper is in her left arm.
- Lady Geist was named **Spectre** in *Neon Prime*, and later renamed to **Ghost**.
- Before Lady Geist's model was updated, there were two work-in-progress models in the files labeled **Ghost_test** and **Ghost_v2**.
- Lady Geist's hairstyle in *The Binding of Oathkeeper* resembles that of Madeline Ashton, a character played by Meryl Streep in the 1992 movie *Death Becomes Her*, who similarly uses magic to stay young. The visual novel's cover also references the movie's opening scene, in which Madeline sits in front of a mirror wearing a teal dress and gloves.
- "Being Fabulous in the Hideout" is displayed as one's status in the in-game Friends List when playing as Lady Geist in the Hideout.
- Lady Geist was referenced in the videogame *Skullgirls Mobile* as a variant of the character Black Dahlia.

## Overview

[edit | edit source]

While her exact motivations change depending on what path she takes in *The Binding of Oathkeeper*, Lady Geist's main goal in the ritual is to prevent Oathkeeper from breaking free and killing her.[1][2][3][4]

### Biography

[edit | edit source]

Lady Jeanne Geist (married name) was born in France in the early 1800s. She married German artist Johann Geist, and moved to America at some point in her life.[5] Jeanne and Johann had a son named Walter in 1850, and Johann died in 1880.[6]

Circa 1890s, when Jeanne was an old lady in a nursing home, the first Maelstrom happened, alerting the public to the existence of the supernatural.[7] At this time, the spirit Oathkeeper approached Jeanne with an offer: Jeanne would make a pact with Oathkeeper to regain her youth in exchange for draining the life of others. She was initially reluctant, but accepted the deal on the grounds that she would choose who dies. However, with the help of Walter, she made a ward to keep Oathkeeper under control. As the ward was "against the spirit of the deal," Oathkeeper promised to make Jeanne suffer if he ever broke free. After Walter died, the responsibilities of maintaining the ward fell on his son, Johann "Jr.", who maintains the ward to the current day.

Now, 50 years after her initial pact and on the eve of the second Maelstrom, Geist has to decide how she'll deal with Oathkeeper, and whether she'll continue to kill others to stay young or accept her natural aging and eventual death.[8]

As the ward containing Oathkeeper is weakening, Lady Geist has to kill more frequently to stay young, going from being able to kill one person to last throughout "swimsuit season", to only getting 2 months of youth for killing three people. Her main victims are usually the homeless.[9][10]

### Personality

[edit | edit source]

Lady Geist holds her public image in extremely high regard.[11][12][13] She seems to have a reputation for being ruthless and doesn't want any acts of kindness to soften her image.[14][15] Lady Geist is exceptional in social settings, being able to "work the room" well enough to impress  McGinnis.[16]

Lady Geist has no moral issues with murdering people, often preferring to kill victims while they're helpless.[17] Despite this, Lady Geist doesn't enjoy killing people, instead seeing it as the only way to survive.[18][19] The thought of aging terrifies Lady Geist.[20]

While cruel, Lady Geist holds the memory of her deceased husband and son in high regard.[21][22][23]

The public are unaware of Lady Geist's deal with Oathkeeper, although rumors about it are circulating.[24][25] The other heroes in the ritual are fully aware that Oathkeeper is bound to Lady Geist. The other heroes often describe Lady Geist as "evil" and a "monster".[26]

### Information

[edit | edit source]

Lady Geist has an old grudge against the Paradox Organisation after they stole one of her husband's paintings 50 years ago.[27][28][29]

Lady Geist is fashionable and well-versed in notable haberdasheries and brands.[30][31][32]

Lady Geist seems to own a foundation for homeless people.[33] Johann Geist used to take her to "hundreds" of fundraisers in the past.[16]

Lady Geist enjoys going to Jezebel's and offers to help prevent the bar from being shut down by the Alchemy Bureau.[34][35][36] She used to like the Baroness Hotel, but believes their "standards went to hell".[37][38] Lady Geist visited the Paradox Museum once, and thought it was "cliché and overwrought".[39]

It's implied that, had Lady Geist made her deal with Oathkeeper transparent, she would've been hunted down by the Baxter Society.[40] The OSIC are aware of her deal with Oathkeeper and are keeping an eye on her, but haven't sent a Sandman after her yet.[41][42][43]

Lady Geist's gun was a gift from Johann Geist.[44]

Lady Geist's hair smells vaguely like flowers.[45]

## Character Relationships

[edit | edit source]

### Oathkeeper

[edit | edit source]

Oathkeeper has been bound to Lady Geist's arm for the past 50 years.

As mentioned in the biography, Oathkeeper wants to kill Lady Geist for binding him as it was "against the spirit of the deal".[46] However, Oathkeeper does like Lady Geist's apathy and considers her "one of his favorites".[47]

Aside from keeping Oathkeeper under control, the ward also prevents Oathkeeper from interacting with the world outside his prison. Lady Geist can choose when she wants Oathkeeper to see or listen to the outside world.[48] Only Lady Geist can hear Oathkeeper speak, with the main exception of  Graves.[49]

### Johann Geist Jr.

[edit | edit source]

Doctor Johann Geist Jr. is Lady Geist's grandson. Like his father before him, Johann Jr. repairs and maintains the ward Lady Geist uses to contain Oathkeeper.[8]

Johann Jr. and Lady Geist have gotten into arguments about Oathkeeper in the past, as Johann believes Oathkeeper is a "cancer".[50]

Lady Geist refers to Johann as "one of the best doctors in New York,"[51] although she also thinks he can be sanctimonious.[52]

Johann Jr. calls Lady Geist "Oma",[53] which is German for "granny".

The relationship between Lady Geist and Johann Jr. can vary depending on the pathway in *The Binding of Oathkeeper.* In storyline G, she sacrifices Johann to the Patrons in order to make Oathkeeper remain obedient to her. However, in storyline H, she chooses to sacrifice herself instead of Johann to banish Oathkeeper from Earth.

### Infernus and Hank

[edit | edit source]

As someone who frequents Jezebel's, Lady Geist is friends with Infernus and Hank.[8]

Lady Geist refers to Infernus as "Fern" and "her bartender".[54][55] She likes Infernus' recipe of gin and tonic.[56]

As Jezebel's is under threat of closure, Lady Geist offers to help Infernus save the bar.[57] In one pathway in *The Binding of Oathkeeper,* Lady Geist gives Oathkeeper to Hank on the promise of providing the resources needed to keep the bar open.[58]

### Kelvin

[edit | edit source]

Kelvin's Arctic expedition was funded by Lady Geist.[59][60] Lady Geist takes great offense if Kelvin is on the enemy team.[61][62]

### Maximilian Fairfax

[edit | edit source]

Lady Geist has worked with Fairfax in the past, being invited to several of his parties.[16][63] Fairfax once showed off  McGinnis to Lady Geist. Both Fairfax and Lady Geist are familiar enough to refer to each other by their first names.[64]

Lady Geist considers Maximilian trustworthy enough to transfer Oathkeeper to. In one pathway in *The Binding of Oathkeeper,* Lady Geist gives Oathkeeper to Fairfax on the grounds that she'll be kept safe.[65]

## Character Interactions

[edit | edit source]

- Lady Geist likes  Mirage and wants to talk to Nashala.[66][67][68]
- Lady Geist finds  Shiv attractive and asks to have a drink with him after the ritual.[69][70]
- Lady Geist is disgusted by  Mo & Krill.[71][72]
- Lady Geist recognises  Pocket, but doesn't know that they're Arin Fairfax.[73][74]
- Lady Geist says  Calico "reeks of new money".[75] She doesn't like Calico's cat, Ava.[76]

- Geist also says the same about  Wraith. However, she respects Wraith for her cunning and ruthlessness.[77]
- Lady Geist believes  Mina has "potential" and respects her ambition.[78][79]
- Lady Geist exclusively refers to  Billy as "William". She refuses to call him Billy.[80]
- Lady Geist offers to introduce  Victor to Johann Jr. to see if he can help Victor before his condition starts to get worse.[15]
- Drifter and Oathkeeper know each other. Drifter wants Lady Geist to set Oathkeeper free.[81][82]
